messages:
maya_pm: quick heads-up — thinking about an "auto-pin rollover" for pinned models. idea: pins expire after TTL and we attempt an automated canary migration with opt-in/customer-credit path. want to vet launch criteria and safe defaults.

aj_dev: high-level sounds useful. question: who owns canary evals? infra or product? also need a per-tenant opt-out flag.

sasha_research: we can reuse the onboard benchmark suite but must add a lightweight latency + embed-drift check. suggest bench_name = onboard-standard-lite.

maya_pm: good. proposed minimum launch gates: 1) canary passes onboard-standard-lite, 2) latency delta <= 2% (p99), 3) embedding drift <= 1% (cosine), 4) cost delta <= 10% per-token. also require customer opt-in/credit for non-default pins. thoughts?

lucas_support: add "no auto-roll for enterprise contracts w/ pin clause". ops needs explicit opt-in or legal flag.

aj_dev: implementation sketch — store pin metadata: ttl_days, canary_size_pct, bench_suite, rollback_triggers. sample config: ```yaml
auto_pin_rollover:
  ttl_days: 90
  canary_size_pct: 1
  bench_suite: onboard-standard-lite
  rollback_on: ["latency>2%", "embed_drift>1%", "cost>10%"]
```

maya_pm: perfect. what about canary schedule? run nightly for TTL-expires, but spread over 7d window to avoid spikes.

tina_engineering: infra note — need KV-cache warming for canaries. small cohort won't populate long-tail caches so measurements might be noisy. recommend canary_size_pct >= 1% and synthetic prefix warmups.

sasha_research: we can add synthetic prefix set per tenant for canary to stabilize p99. also track qual metrics vs golden prompts.

lucas_support: comms: when a pin TTL is near, notify tenant 30d, 14d, 7d with a link to "preview canary" and opt-in toggle. include credits if they accept automated migration.

amaj_dev: (typo) => aj_dev: +1 to notifications and preview UI. also add manual "run canary now" button for SEs.

opsbot: canary-run triggered for tenant: tenant_482 on 1812350123. status: running.

maya_pm: launch criteria checklist for PMs/SEs: - bench pass - infra signoff (cache + rollout policy) - support/comm plan - legal opt-out gating. if all green, auto-rollover mode enabled for cohort.

aj_dev: follow-ups: API changes (pin metadata endpoints), console UI (preview + run now), rollout orchestration. i'll draft epic and owner tags.

sasha_research: I'll add the canary evaluation spec and threshold numbers to the eval repo (bench: onboard-standard-lite).

lucas_support: I'll draft tenant emails and the opt-in credit amounts.

maya_pm: thanks. action items: aj -> epic + infra design doc by EOW, sasha -> bench spec PR, lucas -> comms draft. tagging @tina_engineering for infra review. :thumbsup:
